description: Record why a scoped framework is in scope (write — ADMIN role): basis mcr|dsr, obligation_type and obligation_source. Replaces all three; null clears. Only an active (scoped) framework, else 404.

basis.description: 'mcr' (mandatory compliance requirement) or 'dsr' (discretionary security requirement); null leaves it unclassified. Reclassifying MCR to DSR changes which exclusions need an approver, hence admin-only

framework_id.description: Framework slug of a framework the org has scoped — obtain from scf_get_framework_scope_summary

obligation_source.description: The law, regulation or contract behind it (max 2000 characters); omitted, null or blank clears it

obligation_type.description: Where the obligation comes from: statutory, regulatory, contractual or discretionary; omitted or null clears it

name: scf_set_framework_basis
